items.headline: $QU Drained: Qubic Halts Network After $1.3M Hack
items.summary: Qubic froze its network after attackers exploited weak wallet seeds to drain 2.94T $QU (~$1.3M). Most funds remain immobilized onchain, with MEXC freezing the rest.

items.headline: $CYS Hit: Cysic Halts Bridge After 10M Token Mint
items.summary: Cysic stopped its bridge after an unauthorized mint of 10M $CYS. About 2.8M tokens are frozen, though some were sold before the blacklist kicked in.

items.headline: $ZRO Unveils Aerie With 0.65s Quantum-Safe Signatures
items.summary: LayerZero launched Aerie, hitting sub-second quantum-safe signature benchmarks. A big infra flex for $ZRO as post-quantum narratives heat up.

items.headline: $JST Burns $23.5M in Fifth JustLend Buyback
items.summary: JustLend DAO completed its fifth buyback and burn, torching $23.5M worth of $JST. Supply keeps shrinking as the DeFi protocol leans into deflation.

items.headline: $NEO Turns 10 With HODLers Survival Game Launch
items.summary: Neo celebrates a decade of mainnet with a new HODLers survival game. A fresh community push as $NEO tries to reignite ecosystem activity.
